titulo: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
cuerpo: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page.
